verdict.rationale: BVNK documents programmatic wallet creation through its API, scoped to customers by ID. A probe also found an official agent-wallet CLI repository, which points to first-party agent wallet tooling, but the pack gives no detail on what it does. The safety half of the story has no evidence: Hawk auth secures API requests but nothing shows scoped or limited keys, and payment rules are transfer automation rather than spending policy. missing for 10: scoped/restricted agent keys, policy controls on agent spending, documented movement limits, agent-wallet CLI documentation detail, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can hold and use wallets safely — programmatic wallet issuance for agents with scoped keys, policy controls, and documented limits on what an agent can move

citations.quote: you can create and manage both crypto and fiat wallets through the Portal or API. Specify a customer's ID and reference to create wallets for them
